title: LLM-Assisted Automatic Dispatching Rule Design for Dynamic Flexible Assembly Flow Shop Scheduling

mechanism.domainTask: Dynamic flexible assembly flow-shop scheduling and dispatching-rule design
mechanism.populationDetail: A single flat population of dispatching rules is maintained; reported population size is 4-6, with no island or tree organization.
mechanism.archiveDetail: The best rule is tracked as the output incumbent, but no separate maintained elite archive is defined.
mechanism.replacementDetail: Each iteration builds an offspring set by processing all prompt-neighborhood strategies, then assigns the population to that offspring set; invalid offspring are omitted.
mechanism.generationDetail: The system uses explicit two-parent dominance-fusion, broad exploratory rewriting of parent code, and single-parent directed or parameter-focused modification; no edit region is prescribed.
mechanism.feedbackDetail: Scalar tardiness/objective values remain the quantitative fitness; evaluator-generated semantic advice is reused in later prompts. Best/worst rules provide comparison context, not pairwise preference as the primary signal.
mechanism.parentSelectionDetail: C1 requires two true parents; Algorithm 2 sets parent count by strategy, so there is no single global parent count.
